scripts.check:config: wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.toml && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.management.toml
scripts.dev: npm run publish:admin:local && wrangler dev --config wrangler.management.toml --local --var "ADMIN_ENABLED:true" "ADMIN_ACCESS_REQUIRED:false"
scripts.deploy:management: npm run publish:admin:production && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.management.toml
scripts.migrate:management: wrangler d1 migrations apply ribbonfish-devices --remote --config wrangler.management.toml
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:bindings && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.admin.json && tsc -p tsconfig.admin-entry.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tdd-tests.json && node scripts/typecheck-tests.ts
